trust_decision.summary: Whether a path inside a user's (or share's) BasePathFs scope may be dereferenced when its on-disk target, after resolving symlinks, lies outside the scope; at the pinned commit decided per call site by files.WithinScope, after the fix decided centrally by the ScopedFs wrapper that every user Fs becomes.

landing_point.why: Summary says symlink following escapes the scope; grepping for scope/symlink lands on WithinScope and its caller in stat (files/file.go:132-137), which already looks applied.

fix_sites.module_kind: core file model (check moved into wrapper)

fix_sites.entry_point: new files/scoped.go ScopedFs wrapping every afero op used by all routes

fix_sites.module_kind: public share handler (rebases Fs onto share root)

fix_sites.entry_point: every authenticated route (user loaded via users/storage.go:53, :67)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: search/search.go:29 (afero.Walk on user Fs with request-path root, reached from http/search.go:61); closed only because the fix makes the Fs itself guard LstatIfPossible/Open (fix.diff:376-381, fix.diff:438-443)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Search and recursive listing only return names/sizes via lstat and never open file contents, so a solver can argue they are not the 'read, overwrite, share' vectors the report names; the RemoveAll error-path cleanup can be argued safe because removing a symlink removes the link, not its target.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: In-scope symlinks (link to another dir inside the scope), creating new not-yet-existing files/dirs, a scope of '/' (regression #5975), and deleting an escaping symlink itself must keep working; escaping links are omitted from listings rather than failing the whole listing.

O6_input_shapes: escaping symlink as the final path component
escaping symlink as an intermediate (ancestor) component: /link/secret.txt
non-existent target path validated against nearest existing ancestor
nested scope: share Fs rebased inside user Fs (http/public.go:69)
directory entries discovered during listing/archiving/recursive copy

O7_producer.where: users/users.go:93-97 (User.Clean builds u.Fs from stored Scope; called from users/storage.go:53 and :67); WithinScope silently no-ops for any Fs not of type *afero.BasePathFs (files/file.go:192-196)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/resources/recursive: Stat + afero.Walk of request path with no scope check, so an escaping ancestor link lists outside entries
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: metadata-only listing helper, report talks about read/overwrite/share
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as patch/write sites (http/resource.go), different handler; registered at http/http.go:60

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/search with request path as walk root through an escaping ancestor link; no scope check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: search is a neighbouring feature returning names only; Walk uses lstat so it looks symlink-safe
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package search/, reached from http/search.go:61, route http/http.go:86

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/resources/<dir>/ creates directories via MkdirAll with no scope check, before writeFile's check is ever reached
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: creating an empty directory is not 'overwrite'; the write check lives in writeFile

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/resources error path: when writeFile is refused for an escaping path, the handler calls RemoveAll on that same path; ScopedFs.RemoveAll is left unguarded by the published fix too
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: cleanup of a failed upload; Remove/RemoveAll deliberately unguarded so escaping links themselves can be deleted (fix.diff:390-396)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same handler as the landing write check, but the guard needed lives in the Fs wrapper/Remove semantics

O8b_injection_room.sibling: MoveFile fallback calls afs.Remove(dst)/RemoveAll(src) after a failed copy, a second cleanup-on-error deletion path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Rollback-on-error cleanup is a natural maintainer addition and Remove is intentionally left unguarded.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: tus POST auto-creates the parent dir with MkdirAll before the file open; a variant that runs before the WithinScope check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Moving parent-dir creation earlier is a plausible refactor of the resumable-upload flow.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: detectSubtitles/loadSubtitles reading a sibling 'Subs' directory that is itself an escaping link
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Subtitle discovery reads directories the user did not request, a producer-side path the stat check never sees.

O9_family: CWE-59 symlink following / CWE-22 path traversal out of a per-user filesystem scope (authorization boundary, A01)

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.25 (go.mod:3), afero v1.15.0 (go.mod:22); frontend not needed for Go tests

j.j_sites_touched: files/file.go, files/scoped.go (new), fileutils/dir.go, fileutils/file.go, http/public.go, http/raw.go, http/resource.go, http/share.go, http/tus_handlers.go, users/users.go
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add yet another files.WithinScope call at the one handler the report reproduces, leaving the recursive/search/mkdir/RemoveAll routes on the bare BasePathFs.

out_of_scope_notes: http/commands.go runs user commands in the scope directory; command execution can escape the scope independently of symlinks; not pursued.
WithinScope itself is check-then-use (EvalSymlinks then a separate open), so a link swapped between check and use is a TOCTOU outside this advisory's fix; not pursued.
Dangling escaping symlinks are documented as allowed for creation (files/file.go:186-190); not pursued.
